raw_segments.text: At last the captain made a gesture of despair as though to say,
The boys raised the coffin, but as they passed the mother, they stopped for
a moment and lowered it that she might say goodbye to Alasha.
But on seeing that precious little face, which for
the last three days she had only looked at from a distance, she trembled all over,
and her gray head began twitching spasmodically over the coffin.
